properties.name: Bitterne Beacon

properties.name: Burghclere Beacon
properties.notes: Beacon Hill, Burghclere; Norden 1607 gives approximate grid reference SU4758.

properties.name: Butser Beacon
properties.notes: Butser Hill; north of Coombe on Norden 1595 manuscript.

properties.name: Crondall Beacons
properties.notes: ENE of Ewshott; Norden 1595 describes two hillocks, each with a post.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Dibden Beacon
properties.notes: West of Hythe; also identified as Hythe Beacon / Beacon Hill near Dibden.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Exton Beacon (Lomer)
properties.notes: Lomer Ash / Old Winchester Hill; Lomerash labelled on Hollar 1644 and Lomer Beacon on Kitchin 1751.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Farleigh Wallop Beacon
properties.notes: NW of Farleigh on Norden 1595 manuscript; SW of village on Norden 1595 printed map.

properties.name: Farley Mount Beacon
properties.notes: Farley Chamberlayne; W of Pitt on Norden 1595/1607.
properties.evidence_type: mapped beacon symbol / later place name
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Malwood Beacon
properties.notes: SW of Minstead, New Forest; identification on Norden 1595 printed map is tentative ('perhaps').
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Popham Beacons
properties.notes: Popham Beacons name associated with this location; source warns this may be distinct from Three Barrows and Barrow Beacons.
properties.evidence_type: mapped beacon symbol / later place name
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Portsdown Beacons
properties.notes: Portsdown Hill, north of Cosham; beacon with cresset explicitly described by Collins 1693.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Sarisbury Beacon
properties.notes: East of Swanwick; later place-name evidence includes Bushy Beacon ESE of Sarisbury Green.
properties.evidence_type: mapped beacon symbol / later place name
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Selborne Beacon
properties.notes: Setthorns Enclosure; Morden 1695 gives approximate reference SZ2799. Norden 1607 also labels a Selborne beacon at SU2500, which may represent a different mapped position and needs checking.
properties.evidence_type: mapped beacon symbol; location needs reconciliation
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Toothill Beacon
properties.notes: North of Chilworth; labelled Toothill Beacon on Norden 1595 and 1607.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Sway Beacon
properties.notes: Sway; shown with a tower symbol on Cary's 1789 map.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Farlington Beacon
properties.notes: West of Farlington; listed among the other beacons shown on Norden 1607. Coordinate is the approximate centre of the four-figure grid square.
properties.evidence_type: mapped beacon symbol; approximate grid-square position
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Bramshott Beacon
properties.notes: SE of Bramshott; listed among the other beacons shown on Norden 1607. Coordinate is the approximate centre of the four-figure grid square.
properties.evidence_type: mapped beacon symbol; approximate grid-square position
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Three Barrows
properties.notes: Norden's '3 Parow beacons' is identified by Old Hampshire Mapped as Three Barrows. Kept separate from Popham Beacons; source also notes a possible Three Barrows location at SU507444.
properties.evidence_type: named beacon group; approximate grid reference
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Barrow Beacons (Beacons Farm)
properties.notes: Morden 1695 suggests the beacon was probably on the hilltop near Beacons Farm, Steventon. Distinct candidate from Popham Beacons.
properties.evidence_type: probable beacon site; approximate grid reference
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Titchfield Beacon
properties.notes: West of Titchfield village; identified on Norden 1595 printed map. No grid reference supplied in the source excerpt; geometry intentionally null pending georeferencing.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Burley Beacon
properties.notes: Beacon near Burley is mentioned on Cary 1789 and labelled on later maps. Could be a surviving place-name rather than evidence of an active beacon at that date; geometry unresolved.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons

properties.name: Inkpen Beacon
properties.notes: Named on Weller's 1870s map. Included as a later place-name candidate, not as a confirmed operational warning beacon; geometry unresolved.
properties.source: Old Hampshire Mapped – Map Features: beacons
